newsitem.title: USA: Arbatax Intl acquires oil recycling plant.
newsitem.headline: Arbatax Intl acquires oil recycling plant.

text.p: Arbatax International Inc said on Monday that its 80 percent owned ICHOR unit has acquired an oil recycling facility in McCook, Illinois, from a bankrupt debtor of one of its other subsidiaries.

The company did not disclose the name of the plant's previous owner, the value of the deal and the total debt it was owed. The facility processes used petroleum products to make a recycled lube oil and also disposes of waters contaminated with hydrocarbons, Arbatax said.
The facility is capable of processing approximately one million gallons of waste oil and three million gallons of contaminated water per month, Arbatax said.
Arbatax's Drummond Financial unit was the senior secured lender to the facility's previous owner who filed for bankruptcy on October 25, 1996, the company said.

This allowed for the acquisition of the facility essentially free and clear of all financial liabilities without any cash outlay, Arbatax said. The facility will start production almost immediately and should be at full capacity before the end of the first quarter of 1997, Arbatax said.
